facts.fact: At the Cairo ICT'24 opening the ICT minister briefed the Prime Minister on the Digital Egypt strategy's pillars (digital services, jobs in the digital economy, digital creativity, infrastructure) and gave implementation figures, including 8 million registered on the Digital Egypt platform and 23 of a targeted 32 creativity centres built; the figures are not presented as progress against the strategy's own targets.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
systems.tiers: national; pillars cover digital services for citizens, jobs in the digital economy, entrepreneurship and digital creativity, and infrastructure
